name: Map
author: Clicktrough (maps: the game's own; data from SkeeveAN's Aion-DPS-Meter, MIT, the AION2 Interactive Map, CC BY-NC 4.0, A2 Tools' Pet Soul Tracker, GPL-3.0, and Aion 2 Timers)
description: The map you are on (Verteron, Altgard, Eltnen, Morheim, the Abyss's three layers, Poeta, Ishalgen, 25 instances) with your position and region, every pet monster's spawn points, the pets Pet Finder follows, monsters around, gathering spots, Hidden Cubes, Monolith pieces, Kibelisk camps, sealed dungeons and other places, a search over all of them; and an overlay with a small map that follows you.
